rust_summary: `WorldDrawn::motion`: which mob, player or dropped item each run of the frame's entity quads is.
doc_summary:
`WorldDrawn::motion` in `native_world_drawn`: which mob, player or dropped item each run of the frame's entity
quads is, by its entity id, recorded every frame, so a mod can match an entity's vertices with last frame's. Bundles
that read it need `"hooks": @API:world_drawn_motion@`.
